description: A quality director must decide how to disposition 600 reusable plastic totes after the wrong cleaning chemical was used and finalize the decontamination, testing, and dispatch plan, with input from a quality engineer and a production control coordinator.

shared_context.S1: A batch of 600 reusable plastic totes was cleaned with the wrong alkaline chemical during yesterday's sanitation cycle.
shared_context.S2: The totes are currently segregated from normal packaging inventory, and no totes from this batch may be dispatched until Marisol approves the disposition.
shared_context.S3: The plant uses reusable totes for customer shipments and normally records the cleaning method, verification result, and dispatch quantities in the disposition record.
shared_context.S4: At the daily disposition meeting, Marisol asks quality engineering and production control to report any relevant findings before she approves the plan.
shared_context.S5: Marisol has authority to approve release, scrap, rework, and shipment controls for the tote batch.

PF1.text: Evan's swab and rinse-water review found that 140 totes have absorbed chemical residue and must be scrapped; the other 460 totes can be released only after exactly two fresh-water rinse cycles and a final conductivity result of no more than 50 microsiemens per centimeter. He completed the review this morning, but the signed lab worksheet has not yet been attached to the disposition record.

PF2.text: Nadia confirmed with customer fulfillment this morning that 300 clean totes are required for Monday's 10:00 shipment and the remaining 160 usable totes are required for Wednesday's 14:00 shipment; she received the confirmation in the customer portal, but the dispatch board has not yet been updated.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 460 totes must be released after rework.
The released totes must receive exactly two fresh-water rinse cycles.
The final conductivity acceptance limit must be no more than 50 microsiemens per centimeter.
Exactly 300 released totes must be assigned to the Monday 10:00 shipment.
Exactly 160 released totes must be assigned to the Wednesday 14:00 shipment.
Release must remain blocked until the conductivity test passes.
The release decision must explicitly keep the batch blocked until testing passes.
The chemical-residue finding must be cited by the decision-maker as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The exact residue review changes the disposition to 460 released and 140 scrapped, sets exactly two rinse cycles and a 50-microsiemens limit, and requires the release decision to remain blocked until verification.
The customer confirmation changes the shipment plan to exactly 300 totes by Monday 10:00 and exactly 160 totes by Wednesday 14:00.
